stem: What can the reader conclude from paragraph 1?

options.label: A
options.text: The author is writing for readers who are potential volunteers.

options.label: B
options.text: Aravind Eye Hospital prefers that the people who visit volunteer to help the patients.

options.label: C
options.text: The author spends much of his time volunteering in hospitals.

options.label: D
options.text: Aravind Eye Hospital has a large paid staff and doesn’t depend heavily on its volunteers.
